description: This Java class 'ProtectViewWorker' handles HTTP requests to check if a user login should be tarpit or blocked based on view access frequency, implementing rate limiting and tarpit logic within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProtectViewWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to manage view access protection, rate limiting, and tarpit logic for user sessions.

methods.name: checkProtectedView
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to determine if a user should be tarpit or blocked based on view access frequency, updating tarpit status and returning appropriate messages.
